title: The Last Smile
author: Quentin Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Delacroix, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
